channel.description: Latest articles from South Florida Sun Sentinel (sunsentinel.com)

item.title: A storm system sweeps across the Southeast triggering tornado watches and damaging winds
item.description: A storm system sweeping across the Southeast late Saturday and Sunday brought tornado warnings to Mississippi and Louisiana, and then took aim at parts of Georgia and Florida.

item.title: Heat’s Keshad Johnson revels in NBA dunk championship, ‘now they know who I am’
item.description: From the moment the music started, Miami Heat forward Keshad Johnson made clear this was going to be more than the mundane when it came to the NBA All-Star dunk contest.

item.title: In first public comments since Trump’s racist video, Obama laments lost decorum
item.description: Former President Obama this weekend indirectly addressed a racist video posted this month by President Donald Trump, which depicted Obama and his wife, former first lady Michelle Obama, as apes.

item.title: Trump’s border czar says ‘small’ security force will remain in Minnesota after enforcement drawdown
item.description: By BEN FINLEY WASHINGTON (AP) — White House border czar Tom Homan said Sunday that more than 1,000 immigration agents have left Minnesota’s Twin Cities area and hundreds more will depart in the days ahead as part of the Trump administration’s drawdown of its immigration enforcement surge. item.title: Trump’s border czar says ‘small’ security force will remain in Minnesota after enforcement drawdown
item.description: A “small” security force will stay for a bit to protect remaining agents and respond “when our agents are out and they get surrounded by agitators and things got out of control,” Homan said.

item.title: Rapper turned civic leader Luther Campbell challenges Cherfilus-McCormick in congressional primary
item.description: Luther Campbell, the rap music icon, free-speech advocate & civic activist, launches a Democratic primary challenge to U.S. Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick, who faces a widening field of rivals.

item.title: Armed man is killed by Fort Lauderdale police. ‘The suspect fired his weapon.’
item.description: An armed man who approached police while they were investigating a disturbance in Fort Lauderdale on Saturday was shot and killed by officers, the city’s police chief said.

item.title: Tyler Reddick stuns Chase Elliott, wins Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan’s team
item.description: Tyler Reddick slipped by Chase Elliott to win the Daytona 500 and hand team owner Michael Jordan another championship.

item.title: Heat’s Powell eliminated at All-Star Game as his Team World falls twice
item.description: Norman Powell's first appearance at the NBA All-Star Game afforded the Miami Heat forward the opportunity to play, and lose, in two All-Star Games under the new format.
